summary: SURVIVES_NARROWED. db05f9c is deterministic and structurally clean as an open in-context induction smoke bank, but it does not establish novel-task acquisition or persistent learning. A family-blind stateless support/query parser solved all 24 meta_test_open episodes (24/24; 8/8 each family) with no learning, retained state, weights, or family_id.

evidence.family_blind_symbolic_baseline: 24/24 meta_test_open, 8/8 contradictory_prior, 8/8 goal_inference, 8/8 state_machine; family_id not used

next_action: C2 harness may remain an open development/control-plumbing bank. Do not use it as evidence of persistent novel-task learning or cross-family acquisition. B next reviews frozen runner head 6407f72; require conditions that distinguish stateless support parsing/in-context induction from retained learning, including context-removal and post-update retention before any learning claim.
